name: Calendar, Mail & Reminders
description: Your calendar, email and reminders, through the Mac's own Calendar, Mail and Reminders apps, with every account added there. Hob writes email drafts; you send them.
author: Hob
prompt: For the user's calendar use calendar_events and calendar_add_event; for email use mail_search, mail_read and mail_draft (drafts only: the user sends); and for Reminders use reminders_list and reminder_add. They use the calendar, email and reminder accounts the user connected (a Google or Microsoft account, or the Mac's Calendar, Mail and Reminders apps): don't ask the user to set up a connector for these. Reminders access is requested by macOS the first time Hob uses Reminders. Always get approval before adding a reminder. If access is denied, direct the user to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Reminders.
